title: Evolution by Emergence
description: Evolution by Emergence is an open research corpus and machine-auditable candidate architecture for resource-constrained cumulative evolution. Version v21.1 retains the v21 retained-organization/accessibility and cumulative-reproduction core and adds the audited Step 6 common-ground results. The original repository material is dual-licensed under CC BY 4.0 OR Apache-2.0 as documented in DUAL-LICENSING.md; CC BY 4.0 is supplied here as the single Zenodo archival metadata value because the GitHub-Zenodo metadata path accepts one license value.
